units.source_text: 源氏公子装作没有看见她，依旧向外眺望。

en.t: Prince Genji pretended not to have seen her, and went on gazing outside.

units.source_text: 实则他用眼梢看得很清楚。

en.t: In truth, he could see her quite clearly out of the corner of his eye.
He thought, “I wonder what she is really like.

units.source_text: 如果细看有可爱之处，我多么高兴！”

en.t: If, on closer look, there is something charming about her, how happy I would be!”
But this was only a vain fancy.

units.source_text: 首先，她坐着身体很高，可知这个人上身是很长的。

en.t: To begin with, she looked very tall even while seated, which showed that her upper body was very long.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“果然不出我之所料。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, “Just as I expected.”
His heart gave a different sort of start.

units.source_text: 其次，最难看的是那个鼻子。

en.t: Next, the most unsightly thing was her nose.

units.source_text: 这鼻子首先映入人目，很像普贤菩萨骑的白象的鼻子[\[9\]](#part1335.html#m9)。

en.t: That nose was the first thing to catch the eye, and it closely resembled the trunk of the white elephant ridden by Samantabhadra Bodhisattva[\[9\]](#part1335.html#m9).

units.source_text: 这鼻子又高又长，尖端略略下垂，并带红色，特别教人扫兴。

en.t: The nose was high and long, its tip drooped slightly, and it was tinged red, which was especially disappointing.

units.source_text: 脸色比雪还白，白得发青。

en.t: Her complexion was whiter than snow, so white that it looked bluish.

units.source_text: 额骨宽得可怕，再加下半边是个长脸，这整个面孔就长得稀奇了。

en.t: Her forehead bones were frighteningly broad, and with the lower half of her face so long, her whole face looked strangely formed.

units.source_text: 身体很瘦，筋骨棱棱，形甚可哀。

en.t: Her body was very thin, with sinews and bones sharply protruding, and her figure was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 肩部的骨骼尤为显露，衣服外面也看得出，教人看了觉得可怜。

en.t: The bones of her shoulders stood out especially clearly, visible even through her clothes, and the sight made one feel sorry for her.
